name: telegram-rich-blocks
description: Telegram Bot API rich messages (tables, maps, buttons, details) from Markdown, for agents, scripts and n8n

scripts.build: bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/cli.ts --outfile dist/telegram-rich-blocks-darwin-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 src/cli.ts --outfile dist/telegram-rich-blocks-linux-x64
scripts.build:node: rm -rf lib && bun build src/bin.ts src/index.ts --target=node --format=esm --packages=external --outdir lib && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check && bun test && bun run build:node
